new_boot_authority_counterhypothesis.promotion_risk: After a future real signer pin, plain caller-supplied booleans/strings must not become authority merely because they match policy fields.
new_boot_authority_counterhypothesis.required_future_boundary: A production boot-admit path must itself obtain/bind cryptographic verifier output, canonical admitted/recovery-verified state lineage, and an actually held current kernel/host lease, or consume an equivalent compiler-enforced opaque ClayCode capability.
